mapper.sql: project_costings.id AS id, project_costings.company_id AS companyId, project_costings.pc_code AS pcCode, project_costings.customer_id AS organizationOwnerId, customers.name AS organizationOwnerName, project_costings.customer_contact_id AS personInChargeId, customer_contacts.contact_name AS personInChargeName, project_costings.employee_id AS projectLeaderId, employees.name AS projectLeaderName, project_costings.boq_id AS boqId, boqs.code AS boqCode, project_costings.`date` AS `date`, project_costings.duration AS duration, project_costings.note AS note, project_costings.total_sub_amount + project_costings.total_amount AS totalProjectRevenue, project_costings.total_sub_amount AS totalEstimateCost, project_costings.total_amount AS grossProfitAmount, project_costings.total_percent AS grossProfitPercent, (SELECT color_code FROM project_costing_percent_setting_colors WHERE project_costings.total_percent >= percent_from AND project_costings.total_percent <= percent_to AND project_costing_percent_setting_colors.is_active = 1 ORDER BY project_costing_percent_setting_colors.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS grossProfitColor, project_costings.status AS status, project_costings.created AS created, CONCAT(users1.first_name, ' ', users1.last_name) AS createdBy, CASE WHEN project_costings.status = 2 THEN project_costings.approved ELSE project_costings.disapproved END AS modified, CASE WHEN project_costings.status = 2 THEN (SELECT CONCAT(first_name, ' ', last_name) FROM users WHERE id = project_costings.approved_by) ELSE (SELECT CONCAT(first_name, ' ', last_name) FROM users WHERE id = project_costings.disapproved_by) END AS modifiedBy

FROM project_costings LEFT JOIN companies ON companies.id = project_costings.company_id LEFT JOIN employees ON employees.id = project_costings.employee_id LEFT JOIN boqs ON boqs.id = project_costings.boq_id INNER JOIN customers ON customers.id = project_costings.customer_id LEFT JOIN customer_contacts ON customer_contacts.id = project_costings.customer_contact_id LEFT JOIN users AS users1 ON users1.id = project_costings.created_by

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project_costings ( company_id, pc_code, customer_id, customer_contact_id, employee_id, boq_id, date, duration, note, total_sub_amount, total_amount, total_percent, created, created_by, status ) VALUES ( #{projectEstimation.companyId}, #{projectEstimation.pcCode}, #{projectEstimation.customerId}, #{projectEstimation.customerContactId}, #{projectEstimation.employeeId}, #{projectEstimation.boqId}, #{projectEstimation.date}, #{projectEstimation.duration}, #{projectEstimation.note}, #{projectEstimation.totalSubAmount}, #{projectEstimation.totalAmount}, #{projectEstimation.totalPercent}, NOW(), #{projectEstimation.createdBy}, 1 )

mapper.select: SELECT project_costing_details.id AS id, project_costing_details.project_costing_id AS projectEstimationId, project_costing_details.project_costing_term_id AS projectEstimationTermId, project_costing_terms.number AS projectEstimationTermNumber, project_costing_terms.symbol AS projectEstimationTermSymbol, project_costing_terms.name AS projectEstimationTermName, project_costing_terms.color AS projectEstimationTermColor, project_costing_details.vendor_id AS vendorId, vendors.name AS vendorName, project_costing_details.description AS description, project_costing_details.qty AS qty, project_costing_details.uom_id AS uomId, uoms.name AS uomName, uoms.abbr AS uomAbbr, project_costing_details.unit_price AS unitPrice, project_costing_details.total_price AS totalPrice, project_costing_details.note AS note FROM project_costing_details LEFT JOIN project_costing_terms ON project_costing_terms.id = project_costing_details.project_costing_term_id LEFT JOIN uoms ON uoms.id = project_costing_details.uom_id LEFT JOIN vendors ON vendors.id = project_costing_details.vendor_id WHERE project_costing_details.project_costing_id = #{projectEstimationId}

status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id} AND status > 0;
